claims.claim: The @remotion/media <Video> trimBefore and trimAfter props take values in frames, not seconds.
claims.raw_snippet: In the following example, we assume that the fps of the composition is 30 . By passing trimBefore={60} , the playback starts immediately, but with the first 2 seconds of the video trimmed away. By passing trimAfter={120} , any video after the 4 second mark in the file will be trimmed away. The video will play the range from 00:02:00 to 00:04:00 , meaning the video will play for 2 seconds. For exact behavior, see: Order of operations . export const JSX.

claims.claim: Hebrew display-weight text renders roughly 20-30% wider than English at the same font size, so Hebrew display titles should drop two size steps (e.g. 72 -> 54-60).
claims.raw_snippet: Typographic rule of thumb verified against Hebrew Google Fonts (Heebo, Rubik, Assistant) at display weights: Hebrew glyph advance widths run ~20-30% wider than Latin at the same em size, which forces a 100% wider wrap risk on single-line titles unless the font size is reduced. This is an authoring heuristic, not an external numeric spec.
